description: aweb.secrets.change/1 (docs/design/secrets.md §6.3): a frozen set of widening changes an owner confirms with a passkey through B2. The approval covers "aweb.approval-request/1\n" || canonical_json({policy, request}), with the change set as the request. Positive cases carry those exact bytes and their SHA-256. Negative cases never reach them: refused encodings and shapes, or other bytes. Confirmation cases fix when a change set can be confirmed. The after shapes of secret, destination, operation, grant and policy are added by their owning task (S8), and those of job and runner by S15; until then those kinds are refused. Identifiers are fixtures.

request.reason: Rotate the payments key after the vendor's notice
